notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
This game is fully functional on steam Deck, and works great with the built-in controls and display.


 All functionality is accessible when using the default controller configration
 In-game interface text is legible on Steam Deck
 This game's default graphics configuration performs well on Steam Deck

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE Ver 0.8.0
notes.content:
Changed the boost mechanism as follows: Hold down the boost button to move at high speed, release the boost button to return to original speed
 Modified the HOW TO PLAY explanation
 Changed the crystal break (crystal generation by close-range attacks) mechanism as follows: Generates crystals according to the attack power of the player(Jenny has double the attack power, so the amount of crystals generated is also doubled)
 The volume of sound, SFX, and voice can now be adjusted to 10 levels in the options menu
 Adjusted the priority of message display
 Disabled attacks by the player's ship's jet (due to changes in the boost mechanism)
 Disabled crystal break (crystal generation by close-range attacks) on boss parts after destroying them (bug fixed)
 Added display of player name (Layla or Jenny) and difficulty level to the local ranking list
 Added chiptune arranged music
